title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode7 No Regrets

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Way to go, Haruka...!
It took her barely a second to climb that wall...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She really is the best. I wouldn't even know where to start climbing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither. Her ability to make split-second decisions really is remarkable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not quite the commentary I was expecting, but this is where the real test begins!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Can she do it...?>
<You can do it, Haruka!>
<We're all watching you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everyone's cheering for you, Haruka!
You've gotta clinch victory here!

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Alright, this is the final obstacle our competitor is going to face. The hanging poles!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <She will need to jump from pole to pole by swinging her body like a pendulum! Having to hang above a pool will also add an extra layer of fear!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<There are three poles in total.
This is by far the most difficult obstacle! Will she be able to conquer it?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's about a one-and-a-half meter gap between the poles. I have to get my jumps just right. If I go too far or come up short, I'll fall in.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Use your back and core muscles to swing your body and jump. Here comes... The first one!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Oh, that was a pretty clean jump!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I didn't know Haruka could do stuff like this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I have a good idea of how to jump now...
And I'm moving at a good place.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I can keep this up, then we might finish with the best time...! I need to maintain this momentum and...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That gust was so strong. I missed my chance to jump...)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <She didn't fall, but she finds herself stuck at the second section!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought I could use the momentum I had to keep going, but that's all gone out the window...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Just swing your body, build up momentum and jump...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness...!
Just one to go! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I jump now, the wind will send me off course...! I need this gust to calm a little before...)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<No, she's stopped again!
This gust really is paralyzing! Is this it for her...?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I might be able to go now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The final part is just a jump from the pole to the landing area, but I'll have to fly at least two meters.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'll have to swing myself even harder than before in order to make it to the end.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Is Haruka okay...?
Can she make that jump?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My arms are starting to get really sore...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Creating enough momentum to make that two-meter jump seems next to impossible at this point.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you give up now, then you'll regret it for the rest of your life! So, swing and jump!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Help me out, Akito, Tenma!
She'll succeed if we give her enough support!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just swing!
You can make that jump easy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Right. The three of us did all that training just for this day.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
You can do it, Haruka!
We're all rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They all believe that I can do this.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to fly and spread hope to them!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (First, I need to build back up some momentum...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Use your back and core muscles to swing your body and jump...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Way to go, Haruka!
That was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
She did it...!
That was so cool!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Now I just need to press the button and...!)

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line:
<What a miraculous jump!
She's now using every last ounce of energy she has left to reach the finish line!>

rows.Speaker: Commentator
rows.Line: <Despite everything they had to overcome, our ninth group still managed to finish. With a time of...!>
